title: viola canina var. pyrenaica
intro: Viola canina var. pyrenaica, commonly known as the Pyrenean violet, is a subspecies of the common dog violet (Viola canina) found in the Pyrenees mountain range. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Viola canina var. pyrenaica include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as rutin, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
